theorem AngelDevil.finite_game_determined (p T : Nat) :
    FiniteAngelWins p T ∨ ∃ D, ∀ A, ¬ SafeFor p A D T := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every nonnegative power p and finite horizon T, either one Angel strategy is safe for T rounds against every Devil, or one Devil strategy prevents every Angel strategy from being safe for T rounds. Both strategies use the original history interfaces. At horizon zero the first alternative holds. This is the finite-horizon determinacy step used with compactness in the confinement argument.
source: Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins (2007), https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303, author manuscript pp. 1-2, determinacy observation and Claim 2.1 proof; finite-horizon intermediate statement.
